rationale: From ⲥⲃⲟⲩⲃⲟⲩ 'smooth, polished, bright' (Crum 320a). Substantival cosmic title for the figure that blazes/is manifested in the stars. Reduplicated form suggests intensified brightness.

Lexeme of uncertain identity following 'powers of [the] aromos' modifying stars-and-powers. Possibilities: (a) Greek δρόμος 'celestial course/orbit'; (b) παρόμοιος 'similar'; (c) ἁρμός 'joint, fastening.' Astronomical context (stars + powers of likeness) favors 'course/circuit.' Confidence low; flag for parallel attestations.
Reduplicated form possibly cognate with ⲗⲁⲕⲗⲱⲕ 'soft, smooth, gentle.' Functions as descriptive epithet for the 'great garments.' Confidence low.
Possibly reduplicated form from ⲗⲏⲡⲉ 'twinkling' or ⲗⲁⲙⲡⲱⲛ 'gleam.' Plural noun denoting bright/twinkling cosmic entities resembling the great garments. Confidence low.
Plural relative on ϣⲗ̄ 'pluck (fruit, hair).' Agentive sense 'those who pluck' fits the cosmic harvest-typology where the Living Power reaps Hyle in the five worlds of flesh.

Compound: ⲙⲁ- ('place of') + ⲛ̄- (genitive) + ϫⲓⲟⲟⲣ ('cross over, ferry'). Cosmographic structure for conveying refined light upward. Parallels other ⲙⲁⲛ- compounds in the corpus (ⲙⲁⲛⲭⲟⲣⲉ, ⲙⲁⲛⲣⲁⲓⲥ, etc.).

ⲛⲁⲧⲉ likely plural noun for 'depths, foundations, lower-parts' modifying ⲛⲕⲁⲍ 'lands.' Source-region from which the Power-of-elements comes upward. Confidence moderate; lexeme awaits further parallels.
